8 9 --- 10 11 # goimports-reviser 12 13 ![logo](./images/reviser-muscot_200.png) 14 15 Tool for Golang to sort goimports by 3-4 groups: std, general, company (optional), and project dependencies. 16 Also formats your code (no need to use `gofmt` or `goimports` separately). 17 18 ## Features 19 20 - Sort imports into logical groups (stdlib, general, company, project) 21 - Remove unused imports with `-rm-unused` 22 - Set aliases for versioned packages with `-set-alias` 23 - Format code automatically with `-format` 24 - Apply to directories recursively 25 - Group company imports separately with `-company-prefixes` 26 27 ## Usage 28 29 ### Basic command: 30 ```bash 31 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format ./reviser/reviser.go 32 ``` 33 34 ### Apply to a directory recursively: 35 ```bash 36 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format -recursive reviser 37 ``` 38 39 ### Apply to all files: 40 ```bash 41 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format ./... 42 ``` 43 44 ### Apply to multiple targets: 45 ```bash 46 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format ./reviser/reviser.go ./pkg/... 47 ``` 48 49 ### Options: 50 ```text 51 Usage of goimports-reviser: 52 -apply-to-generated-files 53 Apply imports sorting and formatting(if the option is set) to generated files. Generated file is a file with first comment which starts with comment '// Code generated'. Optional parameter. 54 -company-prefixes string 55 Company package prefixes which will be placed after 3rd-party group by default(if defined). Values should be comma-separated. Optional parameters. 56 -excludes string 57 Exclude files or dirs, example: '.git/,proto/*.go'. 58 -file-path string 59 Deprecated. Put file name as an argument(last item) of command line. 60 -format 61 Option will perform additional formatting. Optional parameter. 62 -imports-order string 63 Your imports groups can be sorted in your way. 64 std - std import group; 65 general - libs for general purpose; 66 company - inter-org or your company libs(if you set '-company-prefixes'-option, then 4th group will be split separately. In other case, it will be the part of general purpose libs); 67 project - your local project dependencies; 68 blanked - imports with "_" alias; 69 dotted - imports with "." alias. 70 Optional parameter. (default "std,general,company,project") 71 -list-diff 72 Option will list files whose formatting differs from goimports-reviser. Optional parameter. 73 -local string 74 Deprecated 75 -output string 76 Can be "file", "write" or "stdout". Whether to write the formatted content back to the file or to stdout. When "write" together with "-list-diff" will list the file name and write back to the file. Optional parameter. (default "file") 77 -project-name string 78 Your project name(ex.: github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser). Optional parameter. 79 -recursive 80 Apply rules recursively if target is a directory. In case of ./... execution will be recursively applied by default. Optional parameter. 81 -rm-unused 82 Remove unused imports. Optional parameter. 83 -separate-named 84 Separate named imports from their group with a new line. Optional parameter. 85 -set-alias 86 Set alias for versioned package names, like 'github.com/go-pg/pg/v9'. In this case import will be set as 'pg "github.com/go-pg/pg/v9"'. Optional parameter. 87 -set-exit-status 88 set the exit status to 1 if a change is needed/made. Optional parameter. 89 -use-cache 90 Use cache to improve performance. Optional parameter. 91 -version 92 Show version. 93 ``` 94 95 ## Examples 96 97 ### Before usage: 98 ```go 99 package testdata 100 101 import ( 102 "log" 103 104 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/testdata/innderpkg" 105 106 "bytes" 107 108 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" 109 ) 110 ``` 111 112 ### After usage: 113 ```go 114 package testdata 115 116 import ( 117 "bytes" 118 "log" 119 120 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" 121 122 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/testdata/innderpkg" 123 ) 124 ``` 125 126 Comments for imports are preserved: 127 ```go 128 package testdata 129 130 import ( 131 "fmt" // comments to the package here 132 ) 133 ``` 134 135 ### Example with `-company-prefixes` option 136 137 Before: 138 ```go 139 package testdata // goimports-reviser/testdata 140 141 import ( 142 "fmt" //fmt package 143 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" //custom package 144 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/pkg" // this is a company package which is not a part of the project, but is a part of your organization 145 "goimports-reviser/pkg" 146 ) 147 ``` 148 149 After: 150 ```go 151 package testdata // goimports-reviser/testdata 152 153 import ( 154 "fmt" // fmt package 155 156 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" // custom package 157 158 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/pkg" // this is a company package which is not a part of the project, but is a part of your organization 159 160 "goimports-reviser/pkg" 161 ) 162 ``` 163 164 ### Example with `-imports-order std,general,company,project,blanked,dotted` option 165 166 Before: 167 ```go 168 package testdata // goimports-reviser/testdata 169 170 import ( 171 _ "github.com/pkg1" 172 .
